issues.summary: Restored pending tx requests skip the router's signer and chain checks; Review then builds against the active Safe's chain, not the dApp's requested chain
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: WalletKitProvider.tsx:68-86 checks only the param shape before pushPending. useSendTransaction.ts:75-78 builds with activeSafe.chainId, and the chainId !== active check (methodRouter.ts:238) never runs on this path, so an eth_sendTransaction restored for another chain gets built on the wrong chain.

issues.summary: Router uses sequential method ifs and a chained ternary instead of lookup tables
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: methodRouter.ts:126-219: each branch has different logic, so a lookup table would add little. mapTxStatus (getCallsStatus.ts:42-43) is a 4-way ternary. Style preference only.

issues.summary: getCallsStatus turns every fetch failure into 'Transaction not found'
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: WalletKitProvider.tsx:330-332 swallows every error. But methodRouter.ts:189-193 always sends -32603, and its comment says jsonrpc-utils replaces the message with 'Internal error', so the dApp can't tell the cases apart anyway. Only the developer-facing hint is lost.

issues.summary: Malformed 'to' passes isValidDappCall and fails later with a generic toast
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: methodRouter.ts:78 accepts any truthy call.to. A bad address only fails in the preview/compose step and shows 'Failed to build transaction' (useSendTransaction.ts:101) while the request stays pending until the user rejects it. Unlikely edge case.

issues.summary: DappIdentity's fallback for URLs that fail to parse is untested
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: DappIdentity.tsx:38-47 has a try/catch fallback, and no test file references DappIdentity. It is simple display logic.

issues.summary: Share-view product change has no Figma reference in its description
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: This is about commit/PR description metadata, not code. The Share/SupportedNetworks changes are in the diff but are process concerns with no concrete defect.

issues.summary: New shared stripEip155Prefix duplicates web's copy, which is not switched to the shared one
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: packages/utils/src/features/walletconnect/utils.ts adds stripEip155Prefix, and apps/web/src/features/walletconnect/services/utils.ts:8 still defines its own, even though it already imports getEip155ChainId/isPairingUri from the package. Small duplication with a drift risk.

issues.summary: ScanQrSend imports useCameraPermissionFlow via a deep path despite the barrel
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: ScanQrSend.container.tsx:7 is unchanged by this PR, and the barrel already exported it (components/Camera/index.ts). Consistency only.

issues.summary: Scanner focus effects turn the camera back on even while the error overlay is shown
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useScan/index.ts:15-26 and ScanQrSend.container.tsx:43-54 call setIsCameraActive(true) on focus without checking errorMessage, while the WC hook gates on status (useWalletConnectScan.ts:67). It only matters if the user leaves and returns to the scanner with an error shown, which is uncommon.

issues.summary: review() re-entry is guarded only by composing state, not a synchronous ref
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useSendTransaction.ts:68-72 sets composing via state. Two taps before the re-render could build twice. That is possible but unlikely at human tap speed.

issues.summary: Call-shape predicate copied from web instead of shared
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: methodRouter.ts:74-82 is a ~8-line predicate mirroring web. Small duplication with no demonstrated drift.

issues.summary: switchActiveChainByCaip2's NOT_DEPLOYED gates are never tested
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: WalletKitProvider.tsx:299-316 holds the only check that stops a dApp from switching to an undeployed or unconfigured chain. Tests only mock it with jest.fn() (methodRouter.test.ts:43,215), and no provider test references it.

issues.summary: Date.now() scanTimestamp could collide for two taps in the same millisecond
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: useScannedAddressToSend.ts:38 runs only after a scan, and the hasScanned/handledRef guards (ScanQrSend.container.tsx:60,76; useWalletConnectScan.ts:133,143) block a second navigation, so a same-millisecond double event can't happen.

issues.summary: useScan test mocks the underlying helpers instead of resolveScannedAddress
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: This is test-design preference. Mocking the lower-level helpers still exercises the real resolveScannedAddress, so there is no concrete cost.

issues.summary: useScan imports scannedAddress via a deep path instead of the new barrel
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useScan/index.ts:6 uses '@/src/components/Camera/scannedAddress' while the barrel (components/Camera/index.ts:3) re-exports it. Import style only.

issues.summary: getCallsStatus status/receipt mapping duplicates web instead of living in the shared eip5792 helper
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: getCallsStatus.ts:39-43 says it is verbatim from web, and web defines PARTIALLY_REVERTED=600 (safe-wallet-provider/index.ts:104), which mobile can't express. That is real duplication and drift risk, but it's a maintainability issue.

issues.summary: HeaderQrButton's fallback setTimeout is never cleared on unmount
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: HeaderQrButton.tsx:37-39 only resets a ref after 500ms, so it does no harm after unmount.

issues.summary: Invalid-params error is built inline, duplicating the private invalidParamsError helper
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: WalletKitProvider.tsx:71 repeats {code:-32602, message:'Invalid call parameters.'} from methodRouter.ts:54. A trivial duplication.

issues.summary: ConfirmTx imports WalletConnect-specific components despite the cross-feature component convention
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: ConfirmTx.container.tsx:19-20 and TransactionHeader.tsx:11 import from features/WalletConnect. mobile docs/code-style.md says components used across features belong in src/components/. This is a minor boundary inconsistency, and the finding's cited path is slightly wrong.

issues.summary: WalletKitProvider inlines several independent jobs and grew very large
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: WalletKitProvider.tsx holds the propose listeners (137-190), the stale-request rejection (199-252) and the deps builders (285-383) inline, against the small-function/one-job guidance in web code-style.md, which mobile adopts. Maintainability cost only.

issues.summary: DappIcon badge uses raw -10 offsets
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: DappIcon.tsx:52 top={-10} right={-10}. Tiny positioning literal, style-level.

issues.summary: SegmentedControl uses a hex '#000' shadowColor instead of a token
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:64 hard-codes '#000', and mobile AGENTS.md says to use Tamagui tokens, not hard-coded values. A minor convention breach.

issues.summary: Provider getCallsStatus (fetch, receipt lookup, no-chain branches) is untested
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: WalletKitProvider.tsx:323-363 has no test coverage: context/__tests__ contain no getCallsStatus references, and only the pure buildGetCallsResult is tested. Regressions in the fetch/receipt wiring would go unnoticed.

issues.summary: A chain switch during an in-flight compose rejects the request, but review() still hands off to confirm
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The switch listener (WalletKitProvider.tsx:212-247) removes and rejects the pending entry, yet useSendTransaction.ts:75-96 resumes after await and calls setOutstandingRequest/router.push with the stale activeSafe. That is real but needs a dApp-triggered wallet_switchEthereumChain inside the preview window, so it is a narrow race.

issues.summary: borderRadius 10/8 magic numbers in SegmentedControl
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: SegmentedControl.tsx:54,62 use literal radii. Style-level, no functional cost.

issues.summary: SegmentedControl's spring animation on value change is untested
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: SegmentedControl.tsx:40-46 skips the first render and then animates, and SegmentedControl.test.tsx has no rerender. The real file is components/SegmentedControl, not the cited path. Minor visual behaviour.

issues.summary: ConfirmTx container wiring for dApp origin and WcRejectOnBack has no test
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: features/ConfirmTx has no container test. WcRejectOnBack and TransactionHeader have their own tests, so only the glue in ConfirmTx.container.tsx is uncovered.

issues.summary: handledRef isn't reset on focus cleanup
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useWalletConnectScan.ts:143 sets it and onTryAgain resets it (line 152). The address path navigates away via replace, so today it only concerns hypothetical future code.

issues.summary: Send and import-account scanners duplicate their scan/error logic
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useScan/index.ts and ScanQrSend.container.tsx:43-92 are near-identical, but the finding itself says two copies may not justify extraction.

issues.summary: The composing half of the dismiss guard is untested
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: RequestSheetHost.tsx:105 has `busy || composing`. RequestSheetHost.test.tsx covers busy (line 177) but not dismiss-while-composing, which is a small coverage gap.

issues.summary: TransactionHeader test lives in __tests__ rather than next to the source
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: There are 47 __tests__ directories in apps/mobile/src and 121 __tests__ files at the base commit, so this follows established practice.

issues.summary: Malformed hex in wallet_switchEthereumChain yields 'eip155:NaN' and a 4901 error instead of -32602
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: methodRouter.ts:149: parseInt('0xzz',16) is NaN, so switchActiveChainByCaip2 returns NOT_DEPLOYED and the dApp gets 4901. The error code is wrong but the switch is safely refused.
